cantinho.title: Cantinho dos bordados
cantinho.description: Landing page for local business of custom embroidery
cantinho.subject: Landing page
cantinho.context: Cantinho dos Bordados is a small embroidery studio that relied mainly on direct contact through Instagram and WhatsApp to present its work and reach new customers
cantinho.approach: I created a dedicated landing page to strengthen the studio's online presence, better present its services and work, and connect the website with the social channels its customers already used
cantinho.result: The website gave the studio a more professional digital presence and made it easier to discover through search engines, while reinforcing its visual identity and providing another channel for attracting new customers

meerkat.title: Meerkat
meerkat.description: Electronics-focused marketplace with a security layer between transactions
meerkat.subject: Marketplace
meerkat.context: Meerkat started as an idea for a new business. I was invited to help develop important marketplace flows, including purchases, exchanges, cancellations, and other parts of the transaction process
meerkat.approach: The solution was designed as a marketplace where people can buy and sell products through a simple and safer process. A mediation layer was introduced into the transaction flow to help prevent fraudulent purchases from reaching the final customer
meerkat.result: The project evolved from an initial business idea into a structured marketplace with its main transaction flows defined and implemented. It is currently being prepared for launch toward the end of 2026

tocata.title: Tocata
tocata.subject: Mobile
tocata.context: The idea came from a problem I experienced while practicing guitar. Repeating a specific part of a song required constantly moving the mouse back to the same timestamp, and the tools I was using did not provide a convenient way to slow the music down for practice
tocata.approach: I first created a web version called RewindIt to validate the idea. After using it, I realized that a mobile experience would be better suited to this type of interaction, so I started rebuilding the application for mobile, renamed it Tocata, and created a new visual identity around the product
tocata.result: Tocata is currently in development and is planned for release by the end of 2026. The project is evolving from a tool created for my own practice into an application designed to make music practice more convenient for other people as well

ecommerce.title: ECommerce management
ecommerce.description: API for managing online commerce following best practices of architecture
ecommerce.subject: Architectural study
ecommerce.context: I created this project to deepen my understanding of software architecture by putting concepts from Clean Architecture and Domain-Driven Design into practice
ecommerce.approach: I modeled the core domain of a basic e-commerce system and used the project to explore concepts such as Domain-Driven Design, Clean Architecture, CQRS, SOLID, and other architectural and design patterns
ecommerce.result: The project gave me a stronger foundation in software architecture and helped me apply these concepts more confidently in other projects, improving both code quality and the way I reason about software systems as a whole

meAndroid.title: Me android
meAndroid.description: Interactive portfolio inspired by the design of Nier:Automata
meAndroid.subject: Interactive portfolio
meAndroid.context: The project was inspired by NieR:Automata, a game whose visual language and interface design I find particularly interesting. I wanted to explore those ideas by creating an interactive portfolio based on the game's aesthetic and atmosphere
meAndroid.approach: Using React and Tailwind CSS, I created a minimalist and interactive website that presents my work through a fictional character instead of following the structure of a traditional portfolio. In the experience, I introduce myself as an android named 7V
meAndroid.result: The result is an unconventional portfolio that combines a minimalist interface, interactive elements, and a strong visual concept to create a more memorable way of presenting my work

trivia.title: Trivia game
trivia.description: Web game in the quiz style with various topics and local ranking
trivia.subject: Web game
trivia.context: The project started as a study exercise focused on building a complete question-and-answer game for the web
trivia.approach: I created a simple and accessible quiz experience where players can test their general or topic-specific knowledge and receive a score at the end of each game, with results recorded in a local ranking
trivia.result: The result is a lightweight and easy-to-play web game that combines a straightforward interface with a complete quiz flow and local score tracking
